compiler.name: clang-cl
compiler.why: Mesa 26.2.6 built with MSVC cl (toolsets 14.51 and 14.44 alike) corrupts the heap linking any program whose fragment shader reads gl_FragCoord.y, and its AddressSanitizer build reports a stack-use-after-scope inside nir_imm_ivec2 inlined into gl_nir_lower_buffers.c, whose source has none. clang-cl comes from the LLVM release already pinned here.

msvc.why: The MSVC toolset whose headers, C runtime and linker the build uses (and whose cl builds zlib and zstd): Visual Studio 2022 17.14's, pinned so that a runner image's newer Visual Studio doesn't change the build unseen.
